title: Salt Gold Rush Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: The rich, smoky tobacco flavour at the heart of Gold Rush would be satisfying enough for any tobacco lover, but SALT have layered it with subtle tones of nuts and spices for an e-liquid of distinctive character and complexity. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices . Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
